title: Generation of mouse hepatobiliary organoids from hepatocyte progenitors and cholangiocytes isolated from healthy adult mouse liver
protocol: Anesthetize a mouse with isoflurane.
Cut the center of the abdominal wall and expose the portal vein.
Insert a butterfly needle into the portal vein and fix it with a clamp.
Turn on the peristaltic pump and cut the inferior vena cava.
Perfuse the liver with 25 ml of pre-perfusion solution at 6 ml/min.
Perfuse 40 ml of perfusion solution at 3 ml/min.
Transfer the liver to a petri dish.
Peel off the liver capsule and dissociate hepatocytes using two tweezers.
Transfer the undigested tissue to a 6 cm dish and keep on ice.
Cut the undigested tissue into small pieces with scissors.
Suspend the tissue pieces in 10 ml of L-15 medium and transfer to a 30 ml beaker containing a stirring bar.
Add 30 mg collagenase, 25 ml hyaluronidase solution, and 10 ml DNase I (5 mg/ml) to the beaker.
Stir the solution at 37°C for 40 minutes.
Add 10 ml of DMEM/F12 medium containing 10% FBS to the cell suspension.
Pass the cell suspension through a 70 μm cell strainer.
Centrifuge at 50 × g for 1 minute to eliminate hepatocytes and cell clumps.
Centrifuge the cell supernatant at 350 × g for 4 minutes to collect dissociated cells.
Resuspend cells in 200 ml of basal medium.
Add 2 ml of anti-CD16/32 (FcgIII/II receptor) antibody and incubate at 4°C for 30 minutes.
Add 2 ml of chilled wash buffer and centrifuge at 350 × g for 4 minutes.
Resuspend cells in 200 ml basal medium.
Add 1 ml of biotin-conjugated anti-EpCAM antibody and incubate at 4°C for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge the cell supernatant at 350 × g for 4 minutes to collect dissociated cells.
Resuspend cells in 100 μl of MACS buffer.
Add 10 μl of streptavidin microbeads and incubate at 4°C for 15 minutes.
Centrifuge the cell supernatant at 350 × g for 4 min to collect dissociated cells.
Resuspend cells in 500 ml of MACS buffer.
Isolate EpCAM⁺ cholangiocytes using MACS.
Centrifuge the EpCAM⁺ fraction at 350 × g for 4 min to collect cholangiocytes.
Count the number of live cells.
Resuspend cells in growth medium at a density of 5×10⁴ cells/300 ml growth medium.
Mix 100 μl of DMEM/NaOH solution, high concentration type I collagen, and autoclaved water to make 1 ml of 4 mg/ml collagen solution.
If the solution is yellow, add 5~10 ml 0.5N NaOH until near neutralization.
Pour 250 μl collagen solution into each well of a 24-well plate.
Incubate the plate at 4°C for 30 min.
Add 500 μl basal medium and incubate 1~2 min at room temperature.
Eliminate the medium by aspiration.
Feed 5×10⁴ cholangiocytes onto each well.
Culture hepatocytes for 5 days.
Dissociate hepatocytes from the liver by two-step collagenase perfusion.
Pass the cell suspension through a 250 μm Nylon mesh.
Pass the cell suspension through a 70 μm cell strainer set on a 50 ml tube.
Centrifuge at 50 × g for 1 min and transfer the supernatant to a new 50 ml tube.
Centrifuge at 50 × g for 1 min and transfer the supernatant to a new 50 ml tube.
Centrifuge at 115 × g for 3 min.
Suspend the pellet in 6 ml of HBSS and add 6 ml of Percoll solution.
Centrifuge at 180 × g for 15 min to eliminate dead cells.
Resuspend cells in 2 ml basal medium and count cells.
Resuspend cells in growth medium at a density of 5×10^4 cells/300 μl.
Eliminate medium from cholangiocyte culture.
Feed 5×10^4 SHs onto each well.
Place the plate in CO₂ incubator.
Replace growth medium with differentiation medium-I at 2 days after SH plating and incubate for 1 day.
Eliminate differentiation medium and overlay cells with 200 μl of collagen gel containing 20% MG (Col-MG).
Incubated the plate at 37°C for 3–4 hours to form a gel.
Add 400 μl of differentiation medium-II to each well.
Replace medium with fresh one every four days.
